name: DMValdez AI Context
author: donaldmvaldez

sections.description:
The DMValdez AI Context plugin is a specialized optimization tool designed to bridge the gap between your website and Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

By generating a clean, virtual /llms.txt endpoint, this plugin ensures that AI search crawlers can instantly digest your exact brand identity, target audience, localized service areas, and vital business URLs without getting lost in messy HTML architecture.

Stop suffering from “AI Technical Debt” and take control of how AI engines recommend your business.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen, or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dmvaldez-ai-context directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new ‘AI Context’ menu item in your sidebar to configure your brand settings.
  4. Click Save, and your virtual /llms.txt file will be instantly generated at your website’s root URL.
